cohort: 1000 women attending an immunization clinic at a tertiary care center in a hilly region of Uttarakhand, India
finding: A substantial percentage (27%) of participants did not follow exclusive breastfeeding practices, and most (81.7%) incorrectly believed breastfeeding should stop after six months or if the child is ill.
mod_finding: Lower segment cesarean section was the most common reason for delay in initiation of breastfeeding.
